# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets security fixes. To update, choose **Check for updates…** in the TheeJ menu.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't report it in a public issue. Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/zolferfigueiredo/theej/security/advisories/new) instead.

Say what you found, how to reproduce it, and your TheeJ and macOS versions. You should get a reply within a week. Once a fix is released, the advisory is published with credit to you, unless you'd rather stay anonymous.
